title: Unmannerly
summary: UNMAN'NERLY, adjective 1. Ill bred; not having good manners; rude in behavior; as an unmannerly youth. 2. Not according to good manners; as an unmannerly jest. UNMAN'NERLY, adverb Uncivilly.
